title: Case studies
deck: I learn how the work runs, find the turn, build it to last, and show what changed.
description: Case studies where I learn how the work runs, find the turn and build a system that lasts, with every number traced to where it came from.
lede: Each case is a different product: a post production startup's website, search and AI footage tagger; a transmittal product for practices that issue drawings; a brand film studio's first website; a dance school's website takeover; and self serve booking with UPI payment for a counselling practice.
Every number carries a label that says how it was found: measured, reported, modelled from inputs you can see, or an example. Each label links to its source.

how.text: I study how the work runs today: the steps people repeat by hand, the files that drift, the parts that break quietly.
I write down the obvious fix and its cost, then look sideways for one that needs less: no licence to buy, no gateway fee, no showreel to wait for.
Few moving parts, tests for what broke once, notes the owner can read, and a way back if something fails.
I put each number beside the work that produced it. Where I cannot measure yet, I model it in the open, with every input shown.

cta.text: If one of these sounds like your business, write to me about how the work runs today.

home.title: Problems I took apart to learn how they worked.
home.line: Each case shows how the work ran before, the turn I took, how small the setup is, and numbers that say where they came from.
